summary: Commit bc8cbd6 cleanly delivers Task 9 scope: project.md gains a `## Use Case Roles` H2 with 10 correctly-named bullets (each linking to docs/usecases/<file>.md via ../../../../docs/usecases/<file>.md) and architecture.md gets a `## Further reading` section pointing to docs/competitive-landscape/, docs/research/condensed-principles.md, and docs/research/paper.pdf. patterns.md is untouched. All relative links resolve on disk (4-up from .claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/ lands at repo root). All Task 9 acceptance criteria pass: AC1 grep returns 12 lines (>=11), AC2 grep non-empty, AC3 file ends with `## Further reading`, AC4 patterns.md diff is 0 lines, AC5 single commit with the prescribed conventional-commit form (chore vs docs scope is a minor variance from spec wording but acceptable).

findings.issue: Tech-spec / task description says insert the Use Case Roles section after 'Key Features'; the commit inserts it after 'Core Problem' (between Core Problem and MVP Scope). The section is present, well-structured, and discoverable, so this is a placement nit rather than a correctness issue.
findings.recommendation: Optional: relocate the `## Use Case Roles` block to immediately follow the `## Key Features` H2 if strict adherence to task instruction is desired. Not blocking.

findings.issue: The `## Further reading` block adds a third bullet pointing to docs/research/paper.pdf, which is not explicitly required by Task 9's two-pointer instruction (competitive-landscape + condensed-principles). The link is valid and the addition is coherent with the docs-actualization feature's foundational-paper theme (Decision 6, Task 7/8), so it improves discoverability.
findings.recommendation: Accept as a small enhancement; if a reviewer wants strict scope minimalism the third bullet could be removed, but keeping it is consistent with WHITEPAPER §References and README's Foundational research section being added in the same wave.

findings.issue: Task 9 prescribes `chore(pk): update project-knowledge references`; actual commit subject is `docs(pk): add Use Case Roles to project.md + competitive/research pointers to architecture.md`. The `docs(pk):` scope is arguably more accurate for a pure docs change and the subject is more descriptive, so this is a positive deviation but still a deviation from the AC's exact-string expectation.
findings.recommendation: No change required; the conventional-commit type/scope is appropriate. Note for AC bookkeeping in pre-deploy QA.

findings.issue: Each bullet duplicates the file path as the link text (e.g. `[docs/usecases/shared-memory-layer.md](../../../../docs/usecases/shared-memory-layer.md)`). On GitHub web the relative target is fine, but the link text is the literal repo-root path while the href is a relative `../../../../` path — mildly redundant.
findings.recommendation: Optional: shorten link text to the filename or use a friendlier label. Not blocking; current form is unambiguous.

findings.issue: Bonus paper.pdf link relies on Wave 3 Task 5 having promoted docs/research/paper.pdf. Verified locally that the file exists (cmp-equal restoration). Behavior on GitHub web for relative links to PDFs is supported.
findings.recommendation: No action required; documenting that the dependency is satisfied at HEAD.

Path resolution: from .claude/skills/project-knowledge/references/ the prefix ../../../../ lands at repo root; ls of all 10 usecase targets, docs/competitive-landscape/, docs/research/condensed-principles.md, docs/research/paper.pdf all succeed.
AC grep on project.md returned 12 lines (heading + 10 bullets + 1 in-line phrase) >= 11.

git diff main vs HEAD for patterns.md: empty (0 lines).
